title: Molecular docking and simulation studies of some pyrazolone-based bioactive ligands targeting the NF- kappa B signaling pathways.
authors: Philip, Surya; Sherin, D R; Kumar, T K Manoj; Badisha Banu, T C; Roy, Reny Mary
one_liner_zh: 该文通过分子对接和MD模拟研究吡唑酮配体靶向NF-kappaB信号通路，但对象为小分子-蛋白互作而非蛋白质-DNA互作，且未涉及TF-DNA结合建模，仅方法部分可借鉴。
abstract: NF-kappaB has become a predominant regulator responsible for multiple physiological and pathological processes. NF-kappaB signaling pathway has canonical and non-canonical components which strategize the cancer-related metabolic processes. Non-canonical NF-kappaB pathways are known to contribute towards the chemoresistance of cancer cells. Consequently, NF-kappaB can be utilized as a potential therapeutic target for modifying the behaviour of tumor cells. In view of this, we herein report a series of pyrazolone-based bioactive ligands that potentially target NF- kappaB and, thereby, unveil their anticancer properties. The pharmacological screening of the synthesized compounds were carried out using various virtual screening techniques. The anticancer studies of synthesized pyrazolones showed that APAU exhibited the most potent effect against the MCF-7 cells with an IC(50) value of 30 mug/ml. Molecular docking studies revealed that the pyrazolones inhibited cell proliferation by targeting the NFkappaB signaling pathway. The molecular dynamics simulation studies predicted the stability and flexibility of pyrazolone-based bioactive ligands.
abstract_zh: NF-kappaB已成为调控多种生理和病理过程的主要调节因子。NF-kappaB信号通路包含经典和非经典组分，这些组分策略性地参与癌症相关代谢过程。已知非经典NF-kappaB通路有助于癌细胞的化学耐药性。因此，NF-kappaB可作为潜在的治疗靶点，用于修饰肿瘤细胞的行为。鉴于此，我们在此报道一系列基于吡唑啉酮的生物活性配体，这些配体可能靶向NF-kappaB，从而揭示其抗癌特性。通过多种虚拟筛选技术对合成化合物进行了药理学筛选。合成吡唑啉酮的抗癌研究表明，APAU对MCF-7细胞表现出最强的抑制作用，其IC(50)值为30 μg/ml。分子对接研究揭示，吡唑啉酮通过靶向NFkappaB信号通路抑制细胞增殖。分子动力学模拟研究预测了基于吡唑啉酮的生物活性配体的稳定性和灵活性。
